summary: Batch 4/4 UI refresh. Frontend only, DEMO mode, 375x667. Window.open was intercepted to check URLs. PASS: Contact detail header has the 'Contacts' back link and 'Edit'. #1001 shows Received 3 / Opened 2 / Clicked 1 plus the 'Recent history' timeline. #1002 and #1004 show 0/0/0 with the exact empty text. #1002 has the red 'Email unsubscribed' tag; the others have the green 'Subscribed' tag. The Contact info card shows Email, Channels tags (Email/SMS, WhatsApp, Landline), Contact ID, Created and Modified. A phone-only contact's title falls back to the number. Edit opens the form with the 'Save' label and read-only email. 'Delete contact' opens the existing confirm ('Delete this contact?' / 'Keep contact'). Confirming deletes the contact, shows a toast and removes it from the list. FORM: all 7 field labels are present. 'Create contact' is pinned. Empty submit shows identifier-banner. WhatsApp-only and landline-only creates both show 'Contact created' with no Undo. A duplicate email shows the inline 'This email already belongs to another contact.' SETTINGS: account card shows avatar, name, email and chevron, and profile-row opens /settings/profile. Organization and Plan rows, the 4 web rows plus Help center, the App toggle (refresh-pref-switch toggles true→false→true) and Sign out are all exact. Every URL opened is exactly as specified. LOGIN: the Terms · Privacy links sit under the note and open termsofuse/privacypolicy; they are visible after sign out. CAMPAIGN: suspending #3 shows the 'Campaign suspended' toast at y=539-586, above the bottom bar at y=594, so 'Resume sending' is not covered. The #1 report opens .../marketing-campaign/report/1. Status pills render with theme-token colors. The schedule sheet recomputes its dates on open (code review). Issues: login hero headline is clipped at 375x667; the contact detail avatar is not tinted; the Plan fallback lacks ' plan'; the toast covers the tab bar on tab screens. No deprecated Expo packages were detected.

ui_bugs.issue: At 375x667 the hero shrinks to its minHeight of 240 (flex:1 with overflow:hidden). The 'Your campaigns and contacts, on the go.' title spans y=227-299 but the hero ends at y=240, so the headline is cut off and mostly invisible. This most likely regressed when the Terms · Privacy row added height below. Fix: let the hero size to its content (no clipping), shrink the preview band (minHeight 140) on short screens, or wrap the screen in a ScrollView. Reference: app/login.tsx styles.hero / styles.preview.

The spec asks for a tinted avatar, but the detail renders a grey avatar. <Avatar label={title} size={80} /> is called without colorId, while the Contacts list passes colorId={c.id} (tinted). As a result the same contact is tinted in the list and grey in the detail. Fix: add colorId={contact?.id}. Reference: app/contact/[id].tsx:232

issues: The demo account has no planName, so the fallback renders 'Subscription · renews 31 Dec 2026' instead of the spec format '<X> plan · renews <date>'. The plan.type fallback does not append ' plan' (settings.tsx:101-103). The demo fixture (src/demo/fixtures.ts account) also lacks planName, so the primary path can't be seen in demo.

After 'Contact created' returns to the Contacts tab, the toast sits at y≈611-650, on top of the bottom tab bar, and hides the tab icons for 4s. setBottomOffset is only used on campaign detail. Consider an offset of tabBarHeight on tab screens.
The Terms/Privacy links are about 34-43x31 px, below the 44pt touch target. Add padding or hitSlop.
On web the refresh-pref-switch renders at 40x20. Confirm the whole row toggles, or give the switch a larger hit area.
The initials become '+1' or '12' (digits from the phone number). Consider a person icon fallback when the label has no letters.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the login hero headline clipping at 375x667 (app/login.tsx hero/preview flex + minHeight + overflow hidden).
MEDIUM: Tint the contact detail avatar: <Avatar label={title} size={80} colorId={contact?.id} /> (app/contact/[id].tsx:232).
MINOR: In the Plan fallback, append ' plan' (e.g. 'Subscription plan · renews ...'), or add planName to the demo account fixture.
MINOR: Lift the toast above the tab bar on tab screens (e.g. setBottomOffset(tabBarHeight) or a default offset inside tabs).
MINOR: Raise the Terms/Privacy touch targets to 44pt using hitSlop or padding.

MINOR (pre-existing): Deep-linking or reloading /contact/form redirects to /login and then to tabs, because the token is restored asynchronously and `if (!token) return <Redirect href='/login'/>` runs before restore finishes. Wait for session hydration before redirecting.
critical_code_review_comments: open-web.ts holds every URL, exactly as specified; webCampaignReportUrl/EditUrl replace <id>. Good.

The demo createContact only simulates duplicate *email*, so the inline WhatsApp/landline/SMS/ext_id duplicate branches (form.tsx:263-266) can't be exercised in demo. They rely on message substring matching ('whatsapp', 'landline', 'sms', 'phone'), which is fragile with real Brevo messages. Prefer the backend 'field' tag when it is present.
Contact detail still renders a separate 'Attributes' card below Contact info. The spec doesn't mention it, and it duplicates SMS/WHATSAPP/name values. Confirm it is intended.

Contact 1001's SMS '+447700900123' (a UK drama-range number) is not resolved to a country by splitStored, so the edit form shows a US +1 flag with '+447700900123' in the national field. Because only changed phones are sent, this is harmless unless the user touches the field. Demo fixture edge case.
The timeline uses delivered ?? messagesSent while 'Received' counts messagesSent. They are consistent in demo but may diverge with real data.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all requested flows functional; 1 HIGH visual regression on login, 1 spec miss on avatar tint)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. In-memory demo contacts created via the form (WhatsApp +12015550177, landline +12015550178/+12015550199). They reset on reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DEMO mode: on /login, tap login-demo-button, then page.goto deep links works, except /contact/form, which redirects on reload. Open the form via add-contact-fab on /contacts instead. Demo contacts: 1001 has activity; 1002 has blacklisted email and no activity; 1003 SMS only; 1004 WhatsApp only; 1005 landline only; 1006 ext_id only. The demo only raises duplicate errors for email. Intercept URLs with add_init_script overriding window.open (expo-web-browser uses it on web). help-center-row sits under the tab bar at first scroll, so use a non-force click (Playwright scrolls it into view) instead of force=True.
